title: Everest Base Camp Trek
shortDesc: Embark on the iconic 14-day foot journey to the base of Mount Everest (8,848.86m), passing Sherpa capital Namche Bazaar, ancient Tengboche Monastery, and Kala Patthar viewpoint.
startEndLocation: Kathmandu to Lukla (Flight) / Return Lukla to Kathmandu
meals: All Meals Included (Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner during trek)
inclusionsText:
- Round-trip domestic flight (Kathmandu/Ramechhap - Lukla)
- Sagarmatha National Park Permit & TIMS Card
- Licensed English-speaking Sherpa Trek Leader & Porters (1 porter per 2 trekkers)
- 13 nights lodge accommodation
- Full board meals on trek (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner)
- Medical kit & pulse oximeter monitoring
- Airport transfers in Kathmandu
exclusionsText:
- International airfare to/from Nepal
- Nepal tourist visa fee ($50 USD)
- Travel & high-altitude medical insurance with helicopter evacuation coverage
- Personal gear & sleeping bags
- Personal expenses (charging, hot showers, Wi-Fi, beverages)
- Tips for guides & porters
addonsText:
- Single room supplement in Kathmandu: $120 USD
- Helicopter return upgrade from Gorak Shep to Lukla: $950 USD per person
- Sleeping bag & down jacket rental: $35 USD each
usefulInfoText: Valid passport required (minimum 6 months validity). Comprehensive travel insurance with medical evacuation up to 6,000m altitude is compulsory.

packageFiles.title: Everest Base Camp Detailed Dossier & Gear List

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu & Transfer to Hotel
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport (KTM), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel. Evening pre-trek briefing with lead Sherpa guide.

itinerary.title: Flight to Lukla (2,860m) & Trek to Phakding (2,610m)
itinerary.description: Early flight to Lukla airstrip. Meet porters and descend along the Dudh Koshi river through pine forests to Phakding village.

itinerary.title: Trek from Phakding to Namche Bazaar (3,440m)
itinerary.description: Cross iconic suspension bridges wrapped in prayer flags including Hillary Suspension Bridge. Steep climb up to Namche Bazaar, the Sherpa hub.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization Day at Namche Bazaar (Hike to Everest View Hotel 3,880m)
itinerary.description: Acclimatization day. Hike up to Syangboche and Everest View Hotel for panoramic views of Mount Everest, Lhotse, Ama Dablam, and Thamserku.

itinerary.title: Trek from Namche Bazaar to Tengboche Monastery (3,860m)
itinerary.description: Walk along winding trails with Ama Dablam towering overhead. Descend to Phunki Thenga before ascending through rhododendron forests to Tengboche Monastery.

itinerary.title: Trek from Tengboche to Dingboche (4,410m)
itinerary.description: Descend through Pangboche and cross Imja Khola river. Ascend into alpine meadows above the tree line to Dingboche valley enclosed by stone walls.

itinerary.title: Second Acclimatization Day at Dingboche (Nagarjun Hill Climb 5,100m)
itinerary.description: Day trip to Nagarjun Hill for vital high-altitude adaptation. Marvel at 360-degree views of Makalu, Lhotse, Chalolatse, and Island Peak.

itinerary.title: Trek from Dingboche to Lobuche (4,940m)
itinerary.description: Ascend gentler slope to Thukla pass, passing stone memorials dedicated to fallen climbers. Continue along lateral moraine of Khumbu Glacier to Lobuche.

itinerary.title: Trek to Everest Base Camp (5,364m) & Return to Gorak Shep (5,164m)
itinerary.description: Trek over rocky glacial moraines to Gorak Shep. Drop gear and trek to Everest Base Camp (5,364m). Celebrate at base camp before returning to Gorak Shep overnight.

itinerary.title: Summit Kala Patthar (5,545m) & Descend to Pheriche (4,370m)
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn climb up Kala Patthar for dramatic sunrise over Mt. Everest peak and Khumbu Icefall. Descend to Gorak Shep for breakfast and continue down to Pheriche.

itinerary.title: Trek from Pheriche to Namche Bazaar (3,440m)
itinerary.description: Retrace steps down the valley through Tengboche and back to Namche Bazaar. Enjoy hot showers and bakery treats in Namche.

itinerary.title: Trek from Namche Bazaar to Lukla (2,860m)
itinerary.description: Final day of trekking. Follow Dudh Koshi river down to Lukla airstrip. Farewell dinner with guide & porter crew.

itinerary.title: Fly from Lukla to Kathmandu & Hotel Transfer
itinerary.description: Morning scenic flight back to Kathmandu. Transfer to hotel for rest, massage, or shopping in Thamel.

itinerary.title: Final Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel and free time until airport transfer for international flight home.

faqs.question: How fit do I need to be for the Everest Base Camp Trek?
faqs.answer: A good level of physical fitness is required. Regular cardiovascular exercises (hiking, stair climbing, running) 2-3 months before departure are strongly recommended.

faqs.question: Is drinking water available on the trail?
faqs.answer: Boiled, filtered, or UV-sterilized water is available at all tea houses. We recommend carrying reusable water bottles and purification tablets or SteriPEN.

faqs.question: What happens in case of acute mountain sickness (AMS) or medical emergency?
faqs.answer: Our guides are trained in wilderness first aid and pulse oximeter monitoring. If emergency evacuation is needed, we arrange immediate helicopter rescue to Kathmandu hospitals.

reviews.author: Marcus Sterling
reviews.content: An incredible once-in-a-lifetime journey. The Alpine Ace Sherpa guides were super professional, attentive to altitude acclimatization, and ensured our safety every step.

reviews.author: Sarah Jenkins
reviews.content: Sunrise on Kala Patthar looking directly at Everest peak was breathtaking. Perfectly organized, delicious meals at tea houses, and wonderful porters!

metaTitle: Everest Base Camp Trek 14 Days | Alpine Ace Treks

title: Annapurna Circuit Trek with Thorong La Pass
shortDesc: Circumnavigate the magnificent Annapurna Massif, crossing high-altitude Thorong La Pass (5,416m), sacred Muktinath Temple, and dramatic Kali Gandaki gorge.
startEndLocation: Drive Kathmandu to Besisahar / Pokhara to Kathmandu
inclusionsText:
- Annapurna Conservation Area Project (ACAP) permit & TIMS card
- Private overland drive Kathmandu to Besisahar / Dharapani
- Licensed Trekking Guide & Porters
- 15 nights lodge accommodation
- Full board meals (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner)
- Flight/Drive from Jomsom to Pokhara & Pokhara to Kathmandu
exclusionsText:
- Personal travel & medical evacuation insurance
- International flight to Nepal
- Personal drinks, hot showers, Wi-Fi
- Tips for guide & porters
addonsText:
- Tatopani hot springs rest day extension: $75 USD
- Ghorepani Poon Hill detour extension: $140 USD
usefulInfoText: High pass crossing at 5,416m requires good endurance. Warm thermal layers and sturdy crampons/microspikes recommended for pass day.

itinerary.title: Drive from Kathmandu to Besisahar & Chame (2,670m)
itinerary.description: Drive from Kathmandu via Marshyangdi river valley through Besisahar up to Chame by 4WD jeep.

itinerary.title: Trek from Chame to Pisang (3,200m)
itinerary.description: Walk through dense pine forests towards Paungda Danda rock face wall into Upper Pisang.

itinerary.title: Trek from Upper Pisang to Manang (3,540m)
itinerary.description: Scenic high route via Ghyaru village offering breathtaking panoramas of Annapurna II, III, IV, and Gangapurna.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization Day in Manang (Ice Lake / Gangapurna Lake Hike)
itinerary.description: Rest and altitude adaptation day. Hike to Gangapurna viewpoint or Ice Lake (4,600m).

itinerary.title: Trek from Manang to Yak Kharka (4,110m)
itinerary.description: Gradual ascent leaving tree line behind. Cross small streams to reach alpine pastures of Yak Kharka.

itinerary.title: Trek from Yak Kharka to Thorong Phedi / High Camp (4,880m)
itinerary.description: Trek along steep slopes to Thorong Phedi and up to High Camp for early rest before pass day.

itinerary.title: Cross Thorong La Pass (5,416m) to Muktinath (3,800m)
itinerary.description: 4 AM early start to cross Thorong La Pass (5,416m). Enjoy prayer flag summits and descend to sacred Muktinath temple.

itinerary.title: Trek/Drive Muktinath to Jomsom & Tatopani Hot Springs
itinerary.description: Descend Kali Gandaki riverbed to Jomsom and drive to Tatopani for natural hot spring bath.

itinerary.title: Trek Tatopani to Ghorepani (2,860m)
itinerary.description: Ascend through traditional Gurung villages of Sikha and Ghara up to rhododendron haven Ghorepani.

itinerary.title: Poon Hill Sunrise (3,210m) & Drive to Pokhara
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn hike up Poon Hill for famous sunrise over Dhaulagiri and Annapurna ranges. Descend to Birethanti and drive to Pokhara lakeside hotel.

itinerary.title: Rest & Sightseeing in Pokhara
itinerary.description: Relax in Pokhara. Optional Phewa lake boat trip, Davis Falls, and World Peace Pagoda visit.

itinerary.title: Drive Pokhara to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Return tourist bus drive to Kathmandu along Prithvi Highway.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Valley Cultural Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Swayambhunath Monkey Temple, Pashupatinath, and Boudhanath Stupa.

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to Kathmandu International Airport for departure.

faqs.question: Is Thorong La Pass dangerous during snow?
faqs.answer: During clear autumn and spring weather, it is safe with experienced guides. If heavy snow occurs, microspikes and guide navigation ensure safe transit.

reviews.author: David Miller
reviews.content: Crossing Thorong La Pass at 5,416m was the toughest and most rewarding thing I have ever done. Incredible views of Mustang and Dhaulagiri!

metaTitle: Annapurna Circuit Trek 16 Days | Thorong La Pass
metaDescription: Trek the full Annapurna Circuit in 16 days. Cross Thorong La Pass (5,416m), visit Muktinath temple & Poon Hill sunrise. Experienced Sherpa guides.
keywords: Annapurna Circuit Trek, Thorong La Pass, Muktinath, Poon Hill Trek, Nepal Trekking

title: Manaslu Circuit Restricted Wilderness Trek
shortDesc: An off-the-beaten-path restricted trek around Mount Manaslu (8,163m), crossing Larkya La Pass (5,106m) with rich Tibetan-Buddhist heritage.
startEndLocation: Drive Kathmandu to Machha Khola / Dharapani to Kathmandu
inclusionsText:
- Manaslu Restricted Area Permit (RAP), MCAP & ACAP permits
- Government registered license guide & porters
- Kathmandu to Machha Khola 4WD jeep drive
- 14 nights lodge accommodation
- Full board meals (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner)
exclusionsText:
- Personal emergency medical & helicopter evacuation insurance
- Nepal visa & international flights
- Personal expenses & tips
addonsText: - Tsum Valley extension detour (7 extra days): $450 USD
usefulInfoText: Manaslu requires a minimum group size of 2 trekkers and a compulsory licensed guide as mandated by Nepal Immigration.

itinerary.title: Drive Kathmandu to Machha Khola (900m)
itinerary.description: Drive from Kathmandu through scenic countryside to Machha Khola via Soti Khola.

itinerary.title: Trek Machha Khola to Jagat (1,340m)
itinerary.description: Follow Budhi Gandaki river through Tatopani hot springs and Dobhan up to Jagat restricted checkpoint.

itinerary.title: Trek Jagat to Deng (1,860m)
itinerary.description: Climb rocky ridge to Salleri and descend to Sirdibas before reaching Deng village.

itinerary.title: Trek Deng to Namrung (2,630m)
itinerary.description: Trek through bamboo and rhododendron forests crossing Budhi Gandaki river multiple times into Nubri region.

itinerary.title: Trek Namrung to Lho (3,180m)
itinerary.description: Enter Tibetan-influenced mountain hamlets with views of Mt. Manaslu North face and Ribung Monastery.

itinerary.title: Trek Lho to Samagaon (3,530m)
itinerary.description: Walk through Shyala village with panoramas of Manaslu Peak (8,163m) and Himal Chuli to Samagaon.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization Day at Samagaon (Manaslu Base Camp Hike 4,800m)
itinerary.description: Excursion to Birendra Lake or high climb up to Manaslu Base Camp (4,800m).

itinerary.title: Trek Samagaon to Samdo (3,860m)
itinerary.description: Follow trail towards Tibetan border past birch forests and juniper bushes to Samdo village.

itinerary.title: Trek Samdo to Dharamsala / Larkya Phedi (4,460m)
itinerary.description: Ascend to Dharamsala high camp base in preparation for pass crossing.

itinerary.title: Cross Larkya La Pass (5,106m) & Descend to Bimthang (3,720m)
itinerary.description: Cross Larkya La Pass (5,106m) enjoying sweeping views of Himlung Himal, Cheo Himal, and Annapurna II. Descend to Bimthang.

itinerary.title: Trek Bimthang to Tilije (2,300m)
itinerary.description: Descend through rhododendron forests along Dudh Khola to Tilije village.

itinerary.title: Trek Tilije to Dharapani & Drive to Besisahar
itinerary.description: Trek down to Dharapani meeting Annapurna Circuit route, then drive by jeep to Besisahar.

itinerary.title: Drive Besisahar to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Drive back to Kathmandu hotel. Evening celebration dinner.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Sightseeing Day
itinerary.description: Relaxation and shopping day in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Airport transfer for international departure.

faqs.question: Can solo trekkers do Manaslu Circuit?
faqs.answer: No, Nepal Immigration regulations require a minimum of two trekkers accompanied by a licensed guide for restricted area permits.

reviews.author: Henri Laurant
reviews.content: Manaslu Circuit was far less crowded than Everest or Annapurna. Crossing Larkya La Pass with snowy peaks all around was unforgettable.

metaTitle: Manaslu Circuit Trek 15 Days | Larkya La Pass
metaDescription: Explore the off-the-beaten-path Manaslu Circuit Trek (15 Days). Cross Larkya La Pass (5,106m) around Mt. Manaslu (8,163m). Book with licensed Sherpa team.
keywords: Manaslu Circuit Trek, Larkya La Pass, Restricted Trek Nepal, Mt Manaslu

title: Langtang Valley & Gosaikunda Sacred Lakes Trek
shortDesc: Discover the valley of glaciers, Tamang heritage villages, Kyanjin Gompa monastery, and sacred high-altitude alpine Gosaikunda Lakes.
startEndLocation: Drive Kathmandu to Syabrubesi / Sundarijal to Kathmandu
inclusionsText:
- Langtang National Park entry permit & TIMS card
- Overland transport Kathmandu to Syabrubesi
- Experienced Tamang/Sherpa guide & porters
- 10 nights lodge accommodation
- Full board meals on trail
exclusionsText:
- Personal emergency travel insurance
- International flights & Nepal visa fee
- Personal beverages & hot showers
usefulInfoText: Closest high-altitude alpine valley trek from Kathmandu valley.

itinerary.title: Drive Kathmandu to Syabrubesi (1,550m)
itinerary.description: Drive north from Kathmandu through Trishuli river valley to Syabrubesi gateway village.

itinerary.title: Trek Syabrubesi to Lama Hotel (2,380m)
itinerary.description: Cross Bhote Koshi river and trek along Langtang Khola river gorge through oak and rhododendron forests.

itinerary.title: Trek Lama Hotel to Langtang Village (3,430m)
itinerary.description: Ascend valley enjoying glimpses of Langtang Lirung (7,227m). Pass Ghodatabela to reach rebuilt Langtang village.

itinerary.title: Trek Langtang Village to Kyanjin Gompa (3,870m)
itinerary.description: Short scenic walk past Mani stone walls and yak pastures to alpine sanctuary Kyanjin Gompa and cheese factory.

itinerary.title: Climb Kyanjin Ri (4,773m) & Explore Glaciers
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn hike up Kyanjin Ri (4,773m) for panoramic views of Langtang mountain rim and icefalls.

itinerary.title: Trek Kyanjin Gompa back to Lama Hotel (2,380m)
itinerary.description: Descend back down Langtang valley through Ghodatabela to Lama Hotel.

itinerary.title: Trek Lama Hotel to Thulo Syabru (2,210m)
itinerary.description: Branch off main route to climb up to beautiful ridge top village of Thulo Syabru.

itinerary.title: Trek Thulo Syabru to Shin Gompa / Lauribina (3,900m)
itinerary.description: Ascend through hemlock and fir forest past Chandanbari cheese factory up to Lauribina ridge.

itinerary.title: Trek Lauribina to Sacred Gosaikunda Lakes (4,380m)
itinerary.description: Climb steep ridge trail to sacred glacial alpine Gosaikunda Lake, revered by Hindu & Buddhist pilgrims.

itinerary.title: Cross Lauribina Pass (4,610m) & Descend to Gopte (3,440m)
itinerary.description: Cross Lauribina Pass (4,610m) and descend steep alpine ridge route to Gopte.

itinerary.title: Trek to Sundarijal & Drive Back to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Final descent through Shivapuri National Park to Sundarijal water source and drive back to Kathmandu.

faqs.question: Are tea houses operational after the 2015 earthquake?
faqs.answer: Yes! Langtang valley and Kyanjin Gompa have been completely rebuilt with resilient lodges, solar amenities, and warm Tamang hospitality.

reviews.author: Chloe Bennett
reviews.content: Langtang valley was peaceful and stunning. The local cheese at Kyanjin Gompa and sunrise at Gosaikunda Lake were unforgettable.

startEndLocation: Lukla to Lukla (Round-trip fly from KTM)
inclusionsText:
- Lukla return flights
- Sagarmatha permit & TIMS
- Expert Sherpa pass guide & porters
- 14 nights lodge accommodation
- Full board meals
exclusionsText:
- Personal emergency travel & evacuation insurance
- Tips & personal drinks
usefulInfoText: Requires glaciated pass crossing over Cho La glacier. Microspikes strongly recommended.

itinerary.title: Fly Lukla (2,860m) & Trek Phakding (2,610m)
itinerary.description: Flight from KTM/Ramechhap to Lukla, trek down to Phakding village.

itinerary.title: Trek Phakding to Namche Bazaar (3,440m)
itinerary.description: Ascend through Sagarmatha National Park entrance up to Namche Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization at Namche Bazaar
itinerary.description: Hike to Everest View Hotel (3,880m) for panorama of Everest and Ama Dablam.

itinerary.title: Trek Namche to Dole (4,200m)
itinerary.description: Diverge from main EBC trail heading towards Gokyo valley through rhododendron forests.

itinerary.title: Trek Dole to Machhermo (4,470m)
itinerary.description: Scenic walk along Dudh Koshi valley slope past Luza village to Machhermo.

itinerary.title: Trek Machhermo to Gokyo Lakes (4,790m)
itinerary.description: Ascend along Ngozumpa Glacier moraine past first, second, and third turquoise Gokyo Lakes.

itinerary.title: Climb Gokyo Ri (5,357m) & Explore 4th/5th Lakes
itinerary.description: Sunrise climb of Gokyo Ri for views of Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, and Cho Oyu.

itinerary.title: Trek Gokyo to Thaknak (4,700m)
itinerary.description: Cross Ngozumpa Glacier lateral moraine to Thaknak base camp below Cho La Pass.

itinerary.title: Cross Glaciation Cho La Pass (5,420m) to Dzongla (4,830m)
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn pass crossing over glaciated Cho La pass (5,420m). Descend down rocky wall to Dzongla.

itinerary.title: Trek Dzongla to Lobuche (4,940m)
itinerary.description: Walk along high ridge with Cholatse and Ama Dablam backdrop to join EBC trail at Lobuche.

itinerary.title: Trek Lobuche to Gorak Shep & Everest Base Camp (5,364m)
itinerary.description: Reach Gorak Shep and trek to Everest Base Camp before returning overnight.

itinerary.title: Kala Patthar (5,545m) & Descend to Pangboche (3,930m)
itinerary.description: Sunrise view on Kala Patthar peak, descend valley to Pangboche village.

itinerary.title: Trek Pangboche to Namche Bazaar
itinerary.description: Return trek past Tengboche monastery down to Namche Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Trek Namche Bazaar to Lukla
itinerary.description: Final day walk back down to Lukla airstrip.

itinerary.title: Fly Lukla to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Morning flight back to Kathmandu. Hotel transfer and tour conclusion.

faqs.question: Which is better: classic EBC or Gokyo Cho La Pass?
faqs.answer: Gokyo Cho La Pass offers a complete loop with pristine turquoise lakes, fewer crowds, and the dramatic Cho La glacier crossing alongside classic Base Camp.

reviews.author: Liam Hemsworth
reviews.content: Gokyo Lakes are even more stunning in person than photos suggest. Crossing Cho La pass with Alpine Ace's guide team was smooth and exhilarating.
